coverage_note.catalog_rows_lack: catalog.json per row = [sha16, kind|subject|cause|verb]; the data payload (damage amounts, was-PT assertions, zone names, counter kinds) is hashed away and layers/replacements/binder dumps are not captured — D1..D5 structurally infeasible there
